content_value: Between Biaxial and Uniaxial Geogrid and Cellular Confinement Technologies, Geosynthetics Have Been at the Forefront of Soil Stabilization Applications Since 1959.

Geocells were first used and patented in the early 80's by the United States Army Corps of Engineers. The early utilization of the cellular confinement technology involved construction of roads over soft soils for military use. Today, BaseLok GeoCell is not only used for base stabilization, but also for erosion control of slopes and channels as well as in construction of retaining walls. The superior effectiveness of our BaseLok GeoCell is made even better thanks to our BaseLok team’s proficiency and technical support. • Superior Ground Stabilization: The 3D cellular structure confines soil and aggregates, improving load distribution and reducing settlement.

100% US Sourced & Manufactured
50+ Years Proven Technology

• Versatile: Ideal for load support, slope protection, erosion control, and retaining structures.
  • Sustainable: Promotes natural drainage and supports vegetation growth for eco-friendly solutions.
  • High Strength: 3D cellular confinement provides superior load distribution and stability.
  • Flexible: Adapts to uneven terrain and performs effectively in weak soil conditions.
  • Fast Install: Lightweight panels expand quickly, enabling rapid and efficient installation.

• Baselok GeoCell is widely used for ground stabilization, load support, and erosion control across a variety of civil engineering and infrastructure projects.
  • • Road Construction – Improves load distribution and stabilizes weak subgrades for longer-lasting pavements.
  • • Slope Protection – Prevents soil erosion and enhances stability on embankments and steep slopes.
  • • Retaining Walls – Reinforces soil structures and improves wall stability.
  • • Railway Infrastructure – Provides subgrade reinforcement and reduces track settlement.
  • • Channel & Riverbank Protection – Controls erosion caused by flowing water and wave action.
  • • Parking Areas & Industrial Yards – Supports heavy loads while minimizing rutting and surface deformation.
  • • Landfill & Waste Containment – Stabilizes cover systems and access roads in landfill environments.
  • • Temporary Access Roads – Creates stable working surfaces in soft or challenging ground conditions.
  • • Coastal & Marine Protection – Helps protect shorelines, canals, and coastal infrastructure from erosion.
  • • Mining & Construction Sites – Provides durable working platforms for heavy equipment and machinery.

BaseLok GeoCell is a high-performance cellular confinement system made from durable polymer materials, forming a honeycomb-like structure that effectively confines soil and aggregates. This confinement enhances load distribution, improves shear strength, and significantly reduces lateral movement, making it ideal for weak and unstable ground conditions.

Compared to traditional stabilization methods, BaseLok GeoCell offers enhanced performance by reducing the need for excessive aggregate fill and minimizing long-term settlement. Its flexible structure adapts to varying terrains, providing consistent support and stability across a wide range of applications.

Designed for use in roads, slope protection, retaining structures, and erosion control systems, BaseLok GeoCell improves structural integrity while enabling faster installation. It also supports vegetation growth and natural drainage, contributing to eco-friendly and sustainable infrastructure development.
